mapper.select: SELECT h.message_count, COALESCE(s.version, 0) AS version, s.metadata, COALESCE(s.pending_user_choices, '[]') AS pending_user_choices FROM harness_thread_hierarchy h LEFT JOIN harness_thread_state s ON s.organization_uuid = h.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = h.workspace_uuid AND s.session_uuid = h.session_uuid AND s.thread_uuid = h.thread_uuid WHERE h.organization_uuid = #{key.Scope.OrganizationUUID} AND h.workspace_uuid = #{key.Scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND h.session_uuid = #{key.Scope.SessionUUID} AND h.thread_uuid = #{key.UUID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO harness_thread_state (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, thread_uuid, version, metadata, pending_user_choices) VALUES (#{key.Scope.OrganizationUUID}, #{key.Scope.WorkspaceUUID}, #{key.Scope.SessionUUID}, #{key.UUID}, #{state.Version}, #{state.Metadata,sensitive=true}, #{state.PendingUserChoices,sensitive=true}) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, thread_uuid) DO UPDATE SET version = EXCLUDED.version, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, pending_user_choices = EXCLUDED.pending_user_choices
